summary: This week in AI, significant advancements were made in various sectors, including healthcare, robotics, and data centers. OpenAI's new AI keypad and Anthropic's Opus 5 model were released, while Meta upgraded its AI chatbot with new productivity features.
insight: The increasing integration of AI in various industries highlights the need for responsible AI development and deployment, with a focus on addressing potential risks and ensuring benefits for all stakeholders.
highlights: OpenAI's ChatGPT Health is now available to all US users, allowing for personalized health insights and medical record integration.
Anthropic's Opus 5 model offers a cheaper and less restrictive alternative to Fable, making it preferable for most use cases.
Meta's AI chatbot upgrade enables new productivity features, enhancing its capabilities beyond just answering questions and generating images.
